title: Satark device event
description: One event emitted by the app (M1) and consumed by the on-device detector (M2). Field names follow the SatarkSim event table. Owner: M2. See x-rules for time, deduplication and missing-signal rules.

t_ms.description: Device clock, epoch milliseconds. Only differences between events are used; the detector never reads the wall clock.

caller_known.description: CALL_START / VIDEO_SESSION_START. false = the other party is not in contacts (unknown contact). null = not reported.

app_package.description: APP_INSTALL / APP_FOREGROUND / VIDEO_SESSION_*: Android package name.

install_source.description: APP_INSTALL only. play_store = installer is com.android.vending; sideload = any other installer or none. null = could not be determined.

payee_id.description: NEW_PAYEE / PAYMENT_ATTEMPT: HASHED payee VPA (hex digest or opaque id). Never a raw VPA, number or name.

payee_is_new.description: PAYMENT_ATTEMPT: the payee is not among the user's known payees. null = unknown.

amount_inr.description: PAYMENT_ATTEMPT: rupees (decimal). From the UPI `am` parameter, or typed by the user when `am` is absent.

payment_type.description: PAYMENT_ATTEMPT: P2M when the UPI URI has an `mc` (merchant code) parameter, else P2P.

source.description: PAYMENT_ATTEMPT from Pay via Satark: how the payment was started. Informational; not a model feature.

x-rules.time: t_ms is the device clock in epoch milliseconds. Events must be passed to the detector in non-decreasing t_ms order (stable for ties); the app sorts by t_ms before dispatch. A clock jump backwards is the app's problem: do not feed events with decreasing time.

deduplication.rule: An event is a duplicate when its key equals the key of the PREVIOUS raw event and the absolute time difference is <= window_ms. The previous event is always the previous raw event, even if that one was itself dropped. The detector applies this rule itself; the app's Deduplicator (M1) must use the same rule and must not be stricter, or genuine repeated payments would be lost.

x-rules.session: The reference detector evaluates self-contained sessions (unknown-contact evidence is never cleared inside a session). When a session starts and ends on a real phone is an app policy; the app calls Detector.reset() at a session boundary and Detector.finish() when it ends. A boundary is not defined by the reference and is not validated by SatarkSim.

payment_attempt_from_pay_via_satark.payee_id: hash of the `pa` (payee VPA) parameter; never stored or sent raw
payment_attempt_from_pay_via_satark.amount_inr: the `am` parameter, or the amount the user types when `am` is missing
payment_attempt_from_pay_via_satark.payment_type: P2M when the URI has an `mc` parameter, else P2P
payment_attempt_from_pay_via_satark.source: qr when scanned from a QR code, manual when typed
payment_attempt_from_pay_via_satark.payee_is_new: true when the hashed VPA is not in the user's known payees

missing_signal_defaults.intro: When a signal source is UNAVAILABLE the field is null (or the event is simply not emitted). The detector then behaves as follows; every case still yields a valid Decision.
missing_signal_defaults.caller_known = null or no CALL events: no unknown-contact evidence: unk_contact_recent, unk_call_active, unk_video_active, payee_added_after_unk, ocss_ordered, the install-during-unknown features and mins_since_unk_log are all 0. The sideload and long-session rules cannot fire. Detection falls back to amount/payee/payment features only.
missing_signal_defaults.install_source = null: the install is neither Play nor sideload: neither install feature is set and the sideload rule cannot fire. The install still counts as an install for ocss_ordered.
missing_signal_defaults.app_package = null: never matches the watch-list; watchlist_app stays 0.
missing_signal_defaults.payee_is_new = null: treated as false: new_payee, newpayee_x_amt, unk_x_newpayee and payee_added_after_unk are 0.
missing_signal_defaults.payee_id = null: the payee is not remembered and not counted: repeat_to_payee is 0 and payee_added_after_unk is 0.
missing_signal_defaults.age_band unknown: the pooled conformal threshold from model.json is used (age_band selects a threshold only and is never a feature).
